name: chat-flow
title: Chat Flow
description: A messaging conversation: outgoing messages type into the composer and send, typing dots precede replies, and reactions pop onto bubbles.
useWhen: A scene needs a messaging conversation that carries your own brand tokens instead of a real platform's chrome.
The whole beat should be scripted from a messages list: outgoing text types into the composer, dots precede replies, reactions pop in.
You want a conversation that reads as chat without naming any messenger.
avoidWhen: The video must read as a specific messenger with its own bubble shapes and chrome.
You only need one message landing on a beat you time yourself: use message-bubble.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Messages
variables.description: JSON array of {"from":"me"|"them","text","reaction"}. Three short messages fit the 12 second default; for a longer conversation lengthen the clip.
variables.default: [{"from": "me", "text": "Hey — ready for the demo?"}, {"from": "them", "text": "Yep, pushing it live now", "reaction": "🔥"}, {"from": "me", "text": "Perfect, sending the link over", "reaction": "👍"}]

variables.label: Contact name
variables.description: Name in the header and on the avatar next to replies. Leave empty to hide the header.

variables.label: Accent color
variables.description: Optional CSS color for outgoing bubbles and the send button. Empty uses the theme primary.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the scripted interaction. 2 plays it twice as fast and holds the end.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the control sits over your own scene.
